7.5 OffsetTimingConstraint
[TPS_TIMEX_00015] OffsetTimingConstraint specifies offset between occur-
rences of events ⌈The element OffsetTimingConstraint is used to specify an
offset between the occurrences of two timing description events.⌋(RS_TIMEX_00001,
RS_TIMEX_00002, RS_TIMEX_00008)
An OffsetTimingConstraint bounds the time offset between the occurrence of
two timing events, without requiring a direct functional dependency between the source
and the target.
